description: Real product-launch videos to use as inspiration templates. Find a reference, then plan a remake for your own product with your own assets.

interface.defaultPrompt: Find launch-video inspiration for my product and plan a remake with my assets.
interface.longDescription: Kuchi is a library of real launch videos, product demos and teasers. Search by product type, motion style, format or aspect ratio, watch each reference, then plan a remake: Kuchi lists what to borrow (pacing, transitions, layout) and which of your own assets it needs (logo, screenshots, features, call to action). No sign-in. Build the video with your own tools.

name: kuchi
